methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: A WorkAI Lab at Roanoke College represents institutional capacity-building outside the NoVA corridor, creating local knowledge infrastructure that could enable peer-to-peer AI fluency distribution across Southwest Virginia's emerging tech ecosystem.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops led by a Norfolk native directly target the distribution dimension—grassroots knowledge transfer that builds local capability rather than depending on platform adoption, potentially bridging Hampton Roads' technology gap through peer networks.

signals.title: RFK Jr., during Monday trip to Danville, says AI will transform rural healthcare
signals.signal_reading: Platform-based AI solutions for rural healthcare in Danville signal shallow but potentially distributed adoption—technology delivered as a service to underserved areas without building local deep capability, reinforcing dependency on external AI providers.

signals.title: Google to invest millions for Virginia workforce development amid data center growth - WRIC ABC 8News
signals.signal_reading: Google's workforce investment tied to data center growth concentrates AI-adjacent skills development in metro areas benefiting from infrastructure expansion, deepening the capability gap between regions with hyperscale facilities and those without.

signals.title: Fairfax Co. students launch AI tool to summarize school board meetings
signals.signal_reading: Fairfax County students building their own AI tools for civic engagement demonstrates deep, generative capability emerging from educational institutions—though concentrated in NoVA, it models the peer-driven skill acquisition that could scale across regions if replicated.
